videos.title: Lewis Howes: The Belief Keeping You Broke Without You Knowing
videos.description:
Money doesn't come to you when you're gripping. It comes when you relax, and almost nobody is relaxed about money.

In this clip, Lewis Howes and Jay Shetty talk about the difference between making easy money and making money easy, and why chasing the quick win is the fastest way to lose everything you've built.

Jay opens up about delivering newspapers for £2 a street at 14, and the belief that came out of it that money is hard, and that people who have it must be doing something shady. Lewis spent a year and a half on his sister's couch in 2008 with no degree, no skills he could name, and student loan debt. Both of them found their way out through the same first habit, and it isn't a budget.

Learn about why your parents' arguments are still setting your salary, what every billionaire Lewis has interviewed says when he asks how they keep creating wealth, and the currency you already have that people with money will pay for.

JAY'S DAILY WISDOM DELIVERED STRAIGHT TO YOUR INBOX

videos.title: Essentials: How to Optimize Female Hormone Health for Vitality & Longevity | Dr. Sara Gottfried
videos.description:
In this Huberman Lab Essentials episode, my guest is Dr. Sara Gottfried, M.D., a Harvard-trained, board-certified gynecologist and expert in female hormone health. We discuss the key biomarkers women should track at each stage of life and how cortisol, thyroid hormone, estrogen, progesterone, and testosterone shape energy, mood, metabolism, and long-term disease risk. We also discuss PCOS, the risks and benefits of oral contraceptives, and the shift in brain metabolism that begins in perimenopause. Dr. Gottfried explains actionable tools for hormone and micronutrient testing, nutrition, stress management, and cardiometabolic screening that women can use at any age.
